title: finance-dashboard
text:
Both done.
Outer repo hygiene (4a6505e)

Tracked files: 15,498 → 34. Untracked, without deleting anything from disk: .venv/ (15,450 files), __pycache__, .DSStore, app/.env, and data/ + postfin_exports/ (bank statements with your IBAN in the filenames). Added a real .gitignore covering all of it, plus finance-dashboard/, which is its own repo with its own remote and was previously neither tracked nor excluded.

I initially swept your loose docs and Python edits into that commit via git add -A, which didn't match the commit message. Nothing was pushed, so I split it and redid the commit cleanly. Your uncommitted work is untouched.

The secret question you'll want the answer to: app/.env was committed back in b957d16 (2025-10-07) with a real GEMINIAPIKEY and HZOHOCALENDERPASS. It has not leaked. The outer repo's origin is thu-vu92/local-llms-analyse-finance, a stranger's project you cloned, and git branch -r --contains HEAD confirms none of your commits exist on any remote. The keys are still in local history, so they'd leak the moment this repo is pushed anywhere. I'd rotate the Gemini key when convenient, and either clear that origin or repoint it at a repo you own.
Rules sync (6b24c3c)

I need to correct what I told you earlier. I said the two rule sets were "drifting in opposite directions." They weren't. I parsed both files and compared rule by rule: the keywords were already in agreement. The 8 Swiss dining merchants are in both, and the 5 rules that looked missing from TS were byte-identical, just renamed (TWINT eating out vs TWINT (eating out)). I was reading commit diffs, not the actual end state.

The one real difference is deliberate and was already documented in the YAML before I touched it: the 5 Commerzbank standing orders split by EUR amount need allKeywords/excludeKeywords, which the Python engine doesn't support, so they stay TS-only.

So there was no reconciliation to perform. The work existed in your working tree and had simply never been committed, which is what 6b24c3c fixes.
Still outstanding

Substantial untracked Python work in the outer repo I did not commit, since you scoped me to hygiene and rules: app/tax/ (engine, export, swisstaxconfig.yaml), app/imports/postfinance.py, app/exclusions.py, app/supabasesync.py, app/ui/dashboardv2.py, app/api.py, plus ~15 loose *.md docs and modifications to main.py, llm.py, data_store.py, README.md, AGENT.md.

Also still open: PR #27 is unmerged, and the tax checklist feature it adds isn't deployed.

Want me to commit that Python work, or merge and deploy #27?
